linhas.txt: Hello! Whose book is this? It's MY book! Whose dog? HER dog! Os possessive adjectives mostram QUEM É O DONO de uma coisa — e olha que legal: eles vêm BEM ANTES da coisa! Vem comigo que a gente treina cada um. Let's go!
POSSESSIVE ADJECTIVES show who something belongs to. They go BEFORE the noun.
it ITS (the dog and its ball)
Tip: the possessive comes BEFORE the noun 'my book', NOT 'book my'.
Careful: ITS igual a belongs to it (its tail). Don't mix with IT'S igual a it is.
